top_8.why: An exact groupoid representation could geometrize the spectral operator, but the identity side is already complete and supplies no sign.
Boundary half-densities could define a Mellin kernel, but natural analytic interpolants already fail off the positive axis.
RHP continuation could expose complex-plane defects invisible to moments; the known Mellin–Pick continuation already has frozen non-Pick points.
Mellin continuation could probe window kernels beyond sampled positive data, but the certified non-real failures block global Pick positivity.
An exact congruence from Weil windows to a moment matrix would be loss-free; no such congruence is known, and Hankel/Toeplitz geometry conflicts.
Formalizing exact finite moment bricks is compatible with all constraints, but by itself creates no new positivity source.
E8 identities might rigidify coefficients, but catalog controls show the data are RH-neutral and do not match Xi positivity.
Support-event leads could become isomonodromic jump data, but the lead law collapsed to the same margin and has no held-out invariant.

T6_candidate_paths.verdict: No independent path found. The three nearest exact routes are known open centers, not new mechanisms.

nearest_misses.name: L* contraction path
nearest_misses.new_theorem: For every admissible window N, the exact source Gram satisfies lambda_max(E_N)<1 with no comparison constant.
nearest_misses.loss_free: This is the exact contraction inequality, not an envelope or constant-factor surrogate.
nearest_misses.assessment_why: It is a sufficient corpus contract; necessity from RH is not established.
nearest_misses.smallest_test: Preregister the next unseen exact window; kill on a certified lambda_max(E_N)>=1 or failed source reconstruction.
nearest_misses.why_killed: This is lemma L* itself, one of the declared open centers, so it is not an independent path.

nearest_misses.name: FREQ mincut path
nearest_misses.new_theorem: Infinitely many faithful selected windows have positive semidefinite cap matrices, proved directly from the exact mincut cone.
nearest_misses.loss_free: Positive semidefiniteness is transferred by exact Loewner implication, without shrinking the margin.
nearest_misses.assessment_why: The Lean chain proves sufficiency, but no converse from RH to this selected family is known.
nearest_misses.smallest_test: Freeze a new cofinal anchor block; kill if every member has a certified negative pivot or violates faithful-fold equality.
nearest_misses.why_killed: The theorem is exactly the named FREQ mincut cone; r456 also shows prefix anatomy can be world-blind.

nearest_misses.name: Countable Gabor positivity path
nearest_misses.new_theorem: The zero-side quadratic is nonnegative for every rational pure-Gabor packet.
nearest_misses.loss_free: The countable criterion is an exact iff and continuity introduces no quantitative slack.
nearest_misses.assessment_why: The inspected Lean file states unconditional rational-packet positivity iff RH.
nearest_misses.smallest_test: Enumerate a preregistered rational packet box with rigorous zero-tail bounds; kill the proposed sub-inequality on one certified negative packet.
nearest_misses.why_killed: The requested theorem is Gabor forall-Z positivity itself, explicitly one of the open centers.
